label: PRIOR_IN_SUBSTANCE_3: PriorInSubstance y x: y is prior to x in substance, that is in perfection
term: prior in substance (prius substantia et perfectione)
definition: `PriorInSubstance y x`: y is prior to x in substance, that is in perfection (prius substantia et perfectione, In Metaph. IX, lect. 9 n. 1, said of distinct beings). A Lean primitive, distinct from simple priority (DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY, characterized by the reduction of potency to act) and from priority in time (DEF-PRIORITY-IN-TIME). No source read for #352 identifies it with simple priority; ActPriorFromIncorruptibleFacts passes to simple priority only through the explicit unattributed hypothesis PriorInSubstanceIsSimpleReading. The linked declaration is the existing PriorityFrame.PriorInSubstance relation projection. IncorruptiblePriorInSubstanceReading constrains this primitive; it does not define it.
note: Primitive boundary: the linked declaration projects an independently supplied binary relation on beings from PriorityFrame Being Respect; it is not a definition by temporal, causal or perfection data. See docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md, Priority semantic linkage audit, for interpretation, dependency boundaries, examples, exclusions and OPEN structural constraints. No statement meaning or frozen Challenge changes.

formal_gap.meaning: PriorityFrame.PriorInSubstance y x says that y is prior to x in substance and perfection: y comes first in the order of what is more complete or perfect, as Aristotle and Aquinas say incorruptible beings are prior to corruptible ones (Met. IX.8, In Metaph. IX lect. 9 n. 1). It is a supplied binary relation on beings, not defined from temporal, causal or perfection data.
examples: An incorruptible being relative to a corruptible one, under the reading IncorruptiblePriorInSubstanceReading (a conditional intended example).
exclusions: Being earlier in time (PriorInTime): chronological age alone is insufficient.
Simple priority (PriorSimply): ActPriorFromIncorruptibleFacts reaches it only through the explicit unattributed hypothesis PriorInSubstanceIsSimpleReading (DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME).
open_obligations: A criterion of perfection sufficient to determine the relation is OPEN.
Irreflexivity, asymmetry and transitivity are not imposed by the frame.
The bridge from priority in substance to simple priority (PriorInSubstanceIsSimpleReading) is open and cannot be made definitional.
Coverage and exclusivity of the three priority senses (STMT-PRIOR-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE, STMT-PRIOR-SENSE-UNIQUE) remain open frontier premises.
Formalization candidate, conditional on new data: given a perfection order on beings, the relation could be defined as strict precedence in that order; the corpus has no such order yet.
